Use the search box and filters to find problems by **mechanics topic, problem type,
competency, industry context, or difficulty**. Each entry is a self-contained scenario
package that can later include student prompts, instructor notes, calculations, rubrics,
and assessment variants.

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-grid-link");

  cards.forEach((cardLink) => {
    const cardBody = cardLink.querySelector(".card-body");
    if (!cardBody || cardBody.querySelector(".packet-actions")) {
      return;
    }

    const problemHref = cardLink.getAttribute("href");
    const problemBase = problemHref.replace(/index\.html$/, "");
    const valuesTable = cardBody.querySelector(".card-other-values");
    const metadata = {};

    valuesTable?.querySelectorAll("tr").forEach((row) => {
      const cells = row.querySelectorAll("td");
      if (cells.length === 2) {
        metadata[cells[0].textContent.trim()] = cells[1].textContent.trim();
      }
    });

    const summary = document.createElement("div");
    summary.className = "card-quick-meta";
    [
      ["Difficulty", metadata.difficulty],
      ["Status", metadata.status],
    ].forEach(([label, value]) => {
      if (!value) {
        return;
      }
      const item = document.createElement("span");
      item.textContent = `${label}: ${value}`;
      summary.appendChild(item);
    });

    if (summary.children.length > 0) {
      cardBody.appendChild(summary);
    }

    const actions = document.createElement("div");
    actions.className = "packet-actions";

    [
      ["Student packet", `${problemBase}student-packet.html`],
      ["Instructor packet", `${problemBase}instructor-guide.html`],
      ["Customize", `./instructor-builder.html?problem=${encodeURIComponent(problemBase)}`],
    ].forEach(([label, href]) => {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = "packet-action";
      button.textContent = label;
      button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        window.location.href = href;
      });
      actions.appendChild(button);
    });

    cardBody.appendChild(actions);
  });
});
</script>
```
